fact: On 18 September 2024 the Adentan Circuit Court (Suit No. C11/003/2023) held Bolt Holdings OU, as data processor, in breach of sections 20, 21, 28 and 30 of the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), awarded the claimant GH₵1.9 million and costs, and ordered the Data Protection Commission to ensure a forensic audit of Bolt's systems and database and of other ride-hailing platforms.
title: Justice Noah Adade vrs Bolt Ghana Limited & Bolt Holdings OU, Suit No. C11/003/2023 (Full Judgment)
publisher: Adentan Circuit Court, Accra (reproduced by Superlaw Ghana)
